# UniTech (ezunitech.com)

> All-in-one platform for Latino contractors & agencies: AI quotes & invoices, scheduling, CRM, digital business cards (QR/NFC), done-for-you bilingual websites and SEO conversion pages.

## What UniTech does
- AI-assisted quotes and invoices
- Scheduling and client CRM
- Digital business cards with QR/NFC
- Done-for-you bilingual (English/Spanish) business websites
- SEO "Conversion Pages" for each service

## Key Pages
- Sitemap: https://ezunitech.com/sitemap.xml

> Individual contractor sites served on their own custom domains expose their own /llms.txt describing that specific business, its services and service area.
